purpose: Curation activities + workarounds register (Marathon R13 lane BA; Lee & Stvilia 2017, PLOS ONE 12(3) e0173987, Texas A&M / Florida State, CC BY — activity structure only, restated in our own words). One appended line per workaround actually in use: {kind: 'curation', record_id, recorded: YYYY-MM-DD, activity, structure, role, skills_needed, contradiction_or_problem, solution_sought, workaround_applied — the study's seven dimensions as the register's columns — status: one of in-use/proposed/retired, note}. Maintained with scripts/wiki_curation.py. This header line is the only line until a real workaround is recorded — seeded empty-but-valid; no workaround is invented here.
